name: pack-shape
description: Product-tree pack shapes shared by every relkit build implementation: entry sets, tree hashes, and refusal faces. Zip framing is not pinned (deflate streams differ across implementations); entry names + contents + tree-sha256 are.

cases.name: bindings-ts-listed-files
cases.description: bindings-ts packs exactly the four listed files.

cases.name: sdk-rust-tracked-tree-with-proto-extra
cases.description: sdk-rust packs the tracked rust sdk tree (Cargo.toml/lock, build.rs, src, README, .gitignore) plus the proto pack extra.

cases.name: sdk-go-go-deps-shape
cases.description: sdk-go packs go.mod/go.sum plus module-internal packages resolved by go list -deps, test files excluded, only the entrypoint packages' own directories.

cases.name: refuses-non-product-tree
cases.description: A binary component is not a packed product-tree.
cases.expectError: store is not a packed product-tree
